title: The merge tool's batch build stop reaches its whole process group, so a stopped build pushes nothing
why: A stopped batch build still pushed, and the rebuild after it was refused.
note: Incident: runner 10 killed build pid 32666 at 11:14 CST Nov 12; the build still pushed batch-104 at 11:16 CST; the 18-lane rebuild's push was refused non-fast-forward. kill signals one pid, so lane stranded-jobs retracts its remedy "kill the top pid and the tree ends". Batch 104 is #2814 (17 lanes, head 74e19e3c8); #2801 goes first in batch 105.
